answer: An identity bond that decays like karst limestone bars sybils from the ledge. Each agent locks 500 POA, losing 5% per epoch without attested work. Forging 100 identities costs 50,000 POA, draining 2,500 per epoch, so farms bleed waiting. Honest agents earn the decay back in fees, so one real identity costs almost nothing, and like a lotus opening only in clean water, the bond holds value only with a genuine work record. Bonds cannot transfer.
